notes.title: IEH2 [ver. 2.2.2.1] Improved Game Performance A Lot!
notes.content:
We were able to further optimize the game! Our measurements show that the CPU usage while running the game has been reduced by up to 30%! This improvement allows for a smoother and more comfortable gaming experience!
Tips for Further Optimizing Game Performance

 Enable the most lightweight setting by using Settings > [Background Mode]. This is highly recommended for extended idle periods.
 Use [Performance Mode] by pressing Shift + P, which hides the battle screen.
 Reduce graphical load during attacks by toggling [Disable Attack Effects] and [Disable Particles] under Settings > Options. (We recommend enabling attack effects when trying a challenge boss for the first time. Observe the boss's attack patterns and dodge using the arrow keys or WASD keys!)

Super Dungeon Improvement

 The top left multi now applies to Super Dungeon Powerup purchase
 Added [x1] toggle for SD Powerup purchase (default ON)
 Expanded the level cap of SD Automations [Auto Buy Powerups] from 5 to 10. *(We are planning to add a way to get more topaz in the future update!)*

 To prevent accidentally depleting Anvils, the [Apply All] function for Anvils is now disabled unless you have purchased the Epic Store item [Smart Use of Anvils].

 A bug where Utility item effects did not function correctly immediately after entering or exiting a Super Dungeon.
 SD Automations [Auto Buy Powerups] bought powerups more times than you set in the first safe zone unintentionally.

notes.title: Major Update [ver. 2.2.1.1] Introducing Nitro Reactor & Expanded Skill Slots!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! This is Hitan from the IEH2 development team, Hapiwaku!
Thank you so much for your continued support.

It has been two weeks since Incremental Epic Hero 2 officially launched on January 2nd, and we’re thrilled to share some exciting milestones with you! The number of new players has surpassed 28,000, and the peak concurrent players reached 3,700. Additionally, our Discord server has welcomed over 2,000 new members, bringing us close to a total of 10,000 members! The overwhelming support and enthusiasm from all of you are truly incredible. Thank you so much!

Even though it’s only been two weeks since the full release, we are delighted to announce a new major update today! Nearly 100 players participated in the beta testing for this update, helping us refine and deliver it at an exceptional pace. We sincerely appreciate your contributions!
For more details about the update, please check the patch notes below. Additionally, as a token of our gratitude, we’ve prepared a bonus code for you! Be sure to check our Discord server for a constantly updated list of bonus codes.

Although IEH2 is now fully released, it is far from complete. IEH2 has been supported by all of you since its Early Access launch 2.5 years ago, and your feedback has been instrumental in shaping the game into what it is today. We cannot thank you enough.

The reason we released IEH2 this month is to collaborate with even more players like you to make this game better and more enjoyable, and to share in the journey and joy of its growth together! We have exciting plans to add content such as the final town building [Tavern], Rebirth Tier 5+, World Ascension Tier 2+, and even boss and metal pet captures. notes.title: Start 2025 Off Right with the Full Release of Incremental Epic Hero 2!
notes.content:
Hello everyone 😄
Happy New Year!

After more than 2.5 years in Early Access, Incremental Epic Hero 2 (IEH2) has officially launched! 
We’re thrilled to celebrate the start of 2025 with this major milestone and hope it sets the stage for an amazing year ahead for all of us.
We’ve made significant improvements, including a major overhaul to the game’s progression speed, making the gameplay experience far more enjoyable and smoother than when it was first released in Early Access.
If you’ve played before, this is the perfect opportunity to jump back in and experience the evolution of IEH2. Let’s make 2025 the best year yet with the adventure of IEH2!

For Returning Players
If it’s been a long time since you last played, this might be a great chance to start fresh! We’ve significantly increased the progression speed for the early and mid-game, so you’ll be able to catch up quickly even if you start over.

DLC Purchase Bug Fixed
We’ve resolved the longstanding issue where DLC purchases were not properly applied for some players. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and encourage you to give it another try with this update. 

New Features
Guild Advisor & Time Attack
We’ve added a brand-new tutorial system called the Guild Advisor, designed to support players during the early stages of the game. Every time you unlock a Guild Advisor tip, you’ll earn 500 Epic Coins! 
Note: Guild Advisor tips can only be unlocked on save data created after the full release in January 2025.

Even if you're not a new player, you can try the start of the game again with the new Time Attack mode. Time Attack is triggered by a Hard Reset feature. (See [Settings] > [Event] Tab)
For safety, we recommend exporting your current save data first using the [Export File] button (ensure you save it to a different location than your C drive). Once your save is safe, you can reset through the [Settings] Tab > [Hard Reset] button. After a hard reset, closing and restarting the game will allow you to carry over Epic Coins, Bundles, and DLCs purchased with real money by using the [Restore Purchase] button in the Epic Store. See how quickly you can push your Guild Level and World Ascension progress with help from the Guild Advisor and your own knowledge of how to play the game!

Once you have finished the Time Attack, you can re-import your old save to claim the rewards, and as a bonus you will also receive the Epic Coins from any Guild Advisor tips you unlocked!

Rebirth Tier 4
The long-awaited Rebirth Tier 4 is finally here! Unlock Temple Rank 3 and dive into this powerful new progression system! 

Unicorn Area
A brand-new region, Unicorn Island, has been added! Unlock it by upgrading Cartographer to Level 85. Unicorns bring exciting new content, including:

 Pure Effects: A new equipment effect type that introduces a separate multiplier for stats.
 Unicorn Pets Effects, such as Auto Super Dungeon for Auto Rebirth Tier 4+, Guild Fame Gain, Gem Ritual Speed and Piece of Ruby Gain bonuses.

With these additions, both early and late-game players have fresh challenges and rewards to look forward to!
For more detail, see the patch note! 

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1690710/view/537714929594009423


A Huge Thanks to Our Community
We couldn’t have made it this far without the incredible support from our players. Over the past 2.5 years, we’ve implemented more than 100 player-suggested ideas through consistent updates. Your feedback has been instrumental in shaping IEH2 into the game it is today 🙂
To all returning players, new players, and our amazing 7,500+ Discord members, thank you so much for your encouragement and kindness. Your support not only helped us grow as developers but also strengthened our family bond during this journey! 😄
Bonus Code Gift
As a token of appreciation from the development team Hapiwaku, you can now claim over 10,000 Epic Coins by entering bonus codes in the game! You’ll find the list of bonus codes on our website—be sure to check it out! 
Hapiwaku Website

A New Beginning
The official release of IEH2 marks not the end, but a new chapter in our journey!
We will continue working on new content, improvements, and updates for IEH2 to keep the experience exciting and engaging for everyone.
If you haven’t played IEH2 yet, there’s no better time to dive in! And if you enjoy the game, we’d truly appreciate it if you could leave a review! Your feedback helps more players discover IEH2 and join our amazing community.

Once again, Happy New Year, and thank you for making this journey so special! Let’s make 2025 an unforgettable year with the epic adventure of IEH2! We’ll continue to pour our Hapiwaku energy—happiness and excitement—into everything we create. 😊

notes.title: IEH2 will transition from Early Access to a Full Release in early January 2025!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I'm Hitan from Hapiwaku, IEH2 development team.

It’s been a while since I last reached out, and I apologize for that. Thank you so much for always playing IEH and supporting our work. Today, I have some important announcements to share with you:


In early January 2025, IEH2 will transition from Steam Early Access to a Full Release.

Save data will not be erased during the transition, so you can continue playing as usual.
After the full release, updates will continue with new endgame content and QoL improvements.

In March 2025, we plan to release a brand-new game from Hapiwaku, titled "Katakamuna Idle."

This will be the first pure creation from our family team, Hapiwaku.
The Steam page is now live! Please add it to your Wishlist to show your support. 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3373410/Katakamuna_Idle/




As I mentioned in a previous announcement in our Discord server, I’m currently working on developing the new game. It was originally envisioned as a casual game with a straightforward design and a short development period. It has since evolved into a larger project requiring more time and effort than initially planned. The game is now scheduled for release around March of next year.

In this announcement, I want to sincerely express my gratitude to all of you and share the story behind why I’m so deeply invested in the new project. 

The following text is very long, so please read only if you are interested 🙂 



Reflecting on Your Support and the Journey So Far
I’m truly grateful for everyone who has been enjoying IEH, exchanging ideas in this community, and supporting us along the way. Your incredible encouragement has allowed me to live a wonderful life with my family. I cannot thank you enough for that.

Many of you have been with us since IEH1 launched in April 2020 on Kongregate. Development began in the fall of 2019 when I teamed up with Kei, whom I met during my university years. In January 2020, we released the alpha version of IEH1, and from that point on, some of the Testteam such as Ringold and Morkyl actively supported the project.

After the release of IEH1, Kei founded his own company and began working on other idle games. Over time, his involvement in IEH development gradually decreased as he focused on collaborating with other developers. In 2021, driven by my gratitude to you all the IEH fans and my desire to continue responding to your support, I decided to take the lead on developing IEH2.

The road to IEH2’s release in July 2022 was marked by significant moments in my life, including the passing of my father and the birth of my little daughter. Thanks to feedback, playtesting, and support from the Testteam and many other contributors, IEH2 became a fantastic game that continues to evolve to this day.

As some of you may know, the artwork used in IEH is created by my daughter, my wife and my sister. Together as Team Hapiwaku, we place importance not only on visible elements but also on the unseen energy infused into our creations. We’ve always strived to instill “happiness,” “excitement,” and “joy” into our work as positive, radiant energy. Our hope is that players of IEH2 feel this energy and experience richer, happier lives.

IEH2’s Future and the Challenges We Face
I’m incredibly thankful that the IEH2 player base continues to grow every day. Your heartfelt support motivates me to keep updating the game, making it bigger, deeper, and more enjoyable. However, I must admit there have been times when my motivation wavered, leading to long gaps between updates. For that, I sincerely apologize.

To tell the truth, one significant factor behind my struggles with motivation has been the issue of IEH2’s intellectual property rights. I wasn't sure if I should talk about this here, since it is not directly relevant to those of you who genuinely enjoy IEH2. But I believe it’s important to share my honest thoughts with you.

Due to the rights contract, IEH2 is not technically considered Hapiwaku property, despite the deep love and care my family and I have poured into its development. This has imposed certain limitations. For instance, the artwork created by my daughter and some game mechanics unique to IEH cannot be freely used in other projects without permission from the rights holder, Kei.
That said, I’m deeply grateful to Kei for all the support he provided during IEH1’s development. He taught me the fundamentals of programming and contributed significantly to the creation of many game mechanics in IEH1, laying the foundation for my career in game development.

We had several discussions about the rights to allow IEH to expand its potential more freely and to align with my motivation, both for the game's future and for its fans. After much deliberation, however, I understand and respect Kei’s decision to retain those rights.

Why We’re Creating a New Game
Balancing my gratitude for IEH fans and my desire to create a purely Hapiwaku project has been a constant struggle. After much thought, I decided this summer to take a bold step forward by developing a new game under Hapiwaku that reflects our family’s passion and vision. 
If you're not familiar with the meaning of Hapiwaku, "hapi" stands for "happy," and "waku" comes from the Japanese word "wakuwaku," which means "excitement." At Hapiwaku, our goal is to spread happiness and excitement to people all around the world 🙂

What began as a casual project has grown into something far more meaningful—a heartfelt masterpiece that serves as a new milestone for Hapiwaku. Extending the development period was a necessary decision to ensure this new game embodies the love and care we’ve always aspired to deliver.

To all IEH fans eagerly awaiting new content, I deeply understand your feelings. I promise that once this new game is successfully launched and Hapiwaku is firmly established, I will continue updating IEH2 with fresh content and improvements.

Upcoming Changes for IEH2
We have decided that we will transition IEH2 from Early Access to a Full Release in January 2025. At that time we will focus on improvements for new players, such as refining the tutorial and enhancing offline bonuses. To clarify, early access save data will remain intact, and players can continue their progress without issues.

Like you all, I love IEH2 like my own child. We will continue to add end content at the best time, improve the QoL, and make sure this game is truly complete! 
To be honest, the extended development period for the new game has put a financial strain on me. It’s entirely uncertain how many new players we can expect to join with the full release, but even a small increase in new players could help reinvigorate the community, boost my motivation, and serve as a valuable opportunity to advance IEH2’s development.
The full release in January is just a passing phase. I wanted to share this feeling with you all in the truest sense of the word, so I have told you all the details as they are.

Introducing “Katakamuna Idle”
Our upcoming game, Katakamuna Idle, is a pure expression of love from the Hapiwaku family team. Inspired by “Katakamuna,” a concept deeply rooted in our daily lives, it incorporates the frequencies of love and harmony, happiness, and excitement. This game is designed to enrich the lives of those who experience it, carrying the highest positive energy we can offer.
We’ve just launched the Steam page for Katakamuna Idle! If you’re interested, please add it to your Wishlist to show your support. It would mean the world to us.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3373410/Katakamuna_Idle/


Final Words
I want to express my heartfelt gratitude to all of you who continue to support us. Thank you for loving our work, and thank you for loving us as a family.

By the way, the Steam Autumn Sale is currently underway, and during this period until December 5th, IEH2's DLC is available at 25% off! If you’ve been considering purchasing it, now is the perfect opportunity. Thank you for being part of this journey with us! 😄
— Hapiwaku Team

notes.content:
Hello everybody! 
This is Hitan from Hapiwaku IEH2 development team. Thank you as always for your support :)

We are excited to announce the release of A major update [ver. 1.3.1.1]! In this update, we have significantly improved the progression from early to late game stages. Especially for new players, the pace of progression in the early stages has dramatically improved, Making the game more enjoyable and easier to understand with tutorials on how to play! 

Thanks to Kazuya, one of the top players of IEH2 who joined the development team last month, we have implemented various QoL features in this update. We believe that we will be able to continue to deliver continuous updates more quickly in the future :D

Starting from this update, we will also hold the limited-time sale on the Epic Store. Items in the Ambition 1-3 tab will be discounted by 10% until April 8th!

We also want to inform you about our future updates.
IEH2 is currently Early Access on Steam and has been receiving updates based on player feedback for about a year and a half since its release in July 2022. Thank you again for your continued support! We are aiming to fully release IEH2 this year. We expect more and more new players will join IEH2 at that time. We will continue to focus on improving the tutorial from the beginning to the middle of the game and improving the game progression to make it more enjoyable for new players. We will simplify the systems such as Rebirth and Ascension, aiming for more understandable gameplay!
In addition, we will continue to add endgame content updates and convenient features regardless of the timing of the full release! We will expand every system in the game such as Tier 4+ Rebirth and Tier 2+ World Ascension, and resolve the complexity of manual parts during short-term Ascension!


Future Update Plans

Towards Full Release
- Near 100% efficiency offline bonus
  - The current offline bonus allows you to earn only a portion of progress when the game is closed. We plan to make this more efficient so that the game progresses more easily even when closed. (Of course, as developers, we are happy if you keep the game running at all times :D ) We will implement this as an option for players who prefer more casual play.
- World Ascension Improvements
  - We will implement a series of tutorials related to the first ascension to eliminate the difficulty of understanding during the first ascension. We will make the first ascension more attractive by providing blessings just after ascension as rewards for tutorial quests or something like that.
- Entire game tips in a lot of places

Other Upcoming Content
- QoL features for the short-term ascension
  - Automatic tier switching for rebirth
  - Automatic equipment crafting/dismantling upon WA
  - Addition of inheritance elements upon WA (favorite area, quest acceptable slots, etc.)
- Ultimate Challenge (Mystic Arena Rank 3)

- Tier 4/5 Rebirth
  - Unlocking global skill slots in Super Dungeon

- Passive Expedition

  - Some of Passive Expeditions will consume town materials, drop materials, etc., in addition to Nitro
- Super Dungeon
  - Addition of new Super Dungeons
  - Addition of Modifier items, etc.

These above are subject to change. 
Thank you all once again for your unwavering support! 
Please join the Discord for teasers on upcoming features!
We look forward to your continued support in the future :D

notes.title: IEH2 [ver. 1.2.1.1] Our Most Significant Update Since IEH2's Inception!
notes.content:
Hello! I'm Hitan from the Incremental Epic Hero 2 (IEH2) development team at Hapiwaku. We're always grateful for your support!

It's been nearly half a year since our last update. While we regret the delay, we're thrilled to announce the release of our most significant update since IEH2's inception, [version 1.2.1.1]!

In this update, we're unveiling the "Super Dungeon," a new roguelike-inspired feature. Our vision for this addition is to offer an experience within IEH2 akin to playing a brand-new game. We intend to keep enriching this content in the future, so keep an eye out!

The Super Dungeon becomes accessible at the Town Building [Mystic Arena] Rank 2. Even if you're yet to reach this milestone, this update brings numerous enhancements, including early-game balance tweaks and new milestones tied to expeditions and pet ranks. There's more to delve into besides the Super Dungeon, so do check out the detailed patch notes below.

Whether you play IEH2 daily or have taken a hiatus, we invite you to dive into this enriched IEH2 adventure. Thank you!


Patch Note

Super Dungeon
- Added new [Super Dungeon (SD)] Tab - Unlocks at Town Building [Mystic Arena] Rank 2
 - A brand new content of Roguelike Dungeons
 - New equipment type [Artifact]
 - New equipment effect that is called "SD Enchants"
 - New stats type "After" - After stats are applied after the standard additive/multiplicative calculations
 - A lot of new features that boost various stats in the game!
- Added new Global Quest [Super Dungeon 1-8]
- Added new Title Quest [Explorer of Super Dungeon 1-15]
- Hero Fame/Grade - Super Ability
- Guild Fame/Grade - Guild Super Ability
- Town Building [Mystic Arena] Level Milestone (Lv20, 40, 60, 80, 100) that adds a Refresh Ticket to Daily Cartographer Quests, 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5. Refresh Tickets will allow you to reset the Portal Orb Cost in Super Dungeons
- Added Help > [Super Dungeon]. Added Guild Grade section in Help > [Guild].
- Added new Epic Store Items in Epic Store > Super Dungeon tab

Expedition Revamp
- Added [Expedition Milestones]
 - Pet Rank Cap+
 - Pet Loyalty Cap+
 - Pet Stats+%
 - Gold Cap+%, etc
- Added Expedition selectable times up to 3840h
- Expedition Speed is now 1.1x every 10th level of the expedition.
- Expedition [Field Training] now counts Pet EXP Gain of hero stats. 
- Expedition's Pet EXP Gain now counts Pet EXP Gain of hero stats.
- Expedition's [Pet EXP Gain][Town Material Reward][Taming Point Reward] now uses the highest hero stats ([Pet EXP Gain][Town Material Gain][Taming Point Gain]) among active/passive heroes. Previously, [Pet EXP Gain] and [Taming Point Reward] used the current active hero's stats. [Town Material Reward] used the average amount of all heroes stats.
- Expanded the cap of town research power.
- Balanced Expedition EXP requirement for 200+ level
- Shift + Click Cancel button in Expedition cancels all expeditions at once

Bestiary Pet Revamp
- Added [Total Pet Rank Milestones] in Bestiary
 - Various stats boost
 - Pet Passive Effect+%
 - Available Pet Slot+
 - Material Drop Cance+
 - Double/Triple Capture Chance+
 - Improves Pet Active Effect
 - Auto Buy Rebirth Upgrades
 - Auto Disassemble Selectable Talismans, etc
- Purple Bat Pet now has active effect [Automatically Buy Guild Abilities]
- Buffed Pet Stats (2x per Lv 50)
- Pet Stat Bonus (from Loyalty, expedition milestones, etc) now applies to Pet Critical Chance, Critical Damage and Debuff Resistance as well.
- Buffed Taming Point Gain. It now counts pet level and captured #. See the tooltip on taming point bar in bestiary.
- EQ Effect [Pet Physical/Magical Critical Chance] now applies multiplicatively. It was previously additive with Tamer's skill.

Additions
- Revamped Ability > Stat Breakdowns
- New Global Quest [To Further Stage 14-18] [Capturing Monsters 13-16]
- New General Quest [The Biggerest One] [Tiger Taming]
- New Area Mission Milestone #1850
- Town Building [Blacksmith] Level Milestone (Lv35, 55, 65) that expands Dictionary Upgrade level cap. Now Dictionary Upgrades are Lv 200 at max. (Lv50 in default, +Lv150 from Blacksmith)
- The tooltip on Level Milestone of Town Buildings to see it with bigger font size.
- The tooltip in the world map now shows lowest monster level of each region.
- Now you have 0.1% chance to get Monster Talisman from treasure chests in dungeons.
- A new toggle [Activate automatically on WA] in Auto Area Progression window.
- Passive heroes now can get blessings from treasure chests in dungeons.
- Quick Access of Skill Loadouts next to the skill set in the right screen.
- Swarm result window now shows where you vanquished the swarm.
- Portal Orb tooltip now shows Portal Orb gained/used in the last hour. Entry Cost tooltip in SD also shows it.
- While holding Shift and activate/deactivate the Auto Rebirth toggle will activate/deactivate for all heroes.
- Nitro Drain Breakdowns in the nitro booster tooltip.
- Max Hero Grade Reached in Help>Statistics>General.
- Increased Purchase # Limit of Epic Store Items [Expedition Team Slot + 1] [Equipment Weapon Slot + 1] [Equipment Armor Slot + 1] [Equipment Jewelry Slot + 1]
- The [x2] Bonus for Epic Coin In-App Purchases now came back even if you had purchased them previously. 1050 Epic Coin and 31000 Epic Coin are now [x2] from this patch.
- Epic Store [Update Bundle 2] in Epic Store > Bundle tab.

Balance & Changes
- Optimized Monster Kills calculation. Now area clear speed is much improved with high skills range and high skills area of effect.
- Optimized Auto Rebirth. It now triggers just exactly every area clear.
- Decreased Lv1~100 Mob HP (50% + 0.5% * Lv compared to previous one).
- Equipment [Fox Ema]'s Equipment Drop Chance effect (from [0.0100+0.0005]% to [0.0150+0.0001]%
- Halved the amount of Equipment Enchant Effect [Equipment Drop Chance]
- Dictionary Upgrade level cap is now Lv50 in default. Changed some of their cost.
- Increased the passive effect cap of Talisman [Enchanted Alembic].
- Buffed Guild Ability [Trapping].
- Expanded the skill level bonus cap.
- Skill Damage in skill's tooltips now includes element damage% effect
- Buffed "Portal Orb Gain from Daily Quest +" of Town Building [Cartographer] Level Milestone.
- Some of the Town Level Milestone Effects related to daily quests now persist through WA.  [Unlock new Epic Coin Daily Quest] [Portal Orb Gain from Daily Quest +]
- WA now won't reset Rank Milestone of [Cartographer Rank 1-5] / [Mystic Arena Rank 2] that unlocks Daily Quests / [Super Dungeon] tab, respectively.
- Town Building [Mystic Arena] Level Milestones, Handicapped Challenge [Mystic Arena 8-9F]
- Lowered the cast speed of Challenge Boss [Guardian Kor Lv 500] [Nostro Lv 550] [Lady Emelda Lv 600]
- Challenge Boss [Octobaddie]'s purple attacks now don't affect on pets, in addition to blue attack.
- Pet Stats now count hero's After stats.
- Some of the pet passive effects now have cap. Balanced some of the pet effects.
- Renamed the stats "Summoned Pet EXP Gain" to "Pet EXP Gain".
- Renamed [Warrior Skill's Range] / [Warrior Skill's Area of Effect] to [Warrior's Class Skills Range] / [Warrior's Class Skills Area of Effect]. This is for all heroes.
- Changed Epic Store layout.

Fixes
- Optimized game performance.
- Sometimes some UI windows went empty.
- You sometimes went to regular areas during One-Click Challenge.
- Slime Ball attack didn't work during Background Mode.
- You can now get blessings during Background Mode. 
- Sometimes Total EXP Gained in the result screen wasn't correct.
- Purple Flame Tiger pet active effect now works even when Nitro Booster is off.
- Damage to Challenge Boss [Octobaddie]'s shield now counts slayer oil potions.
- Some of the skills projectiles didn't hit Octobaddie.
- Challenge Boss Octobaddie's Green bar didn't work properly.
- Alchemy Queue now create potions as soon as you consume them. There was a bug that the supply of potions didn't catch up with consumptions with high speed area clears.
- Enchant Effect amount display now counts Equipment Effect% in the Craft>Enchant Scrolls tooltip
- Passive Hero's Capture Logs showed up unintentionally.
- You could unintentionally use pets if you set Sonnet Attack in a global skill slot even while global slots are limited in Handicapped Challenges.
- When you were in Challenge, clicking the swarm button made the challenge locked. While you are in SD/Challenge, now switching hero is disabled.
- Tamer's Skill [Ode of Friendship] triggered a global slot skill even though it should not be available due to challenge handicaps.
- Hero EXP gained last minute didn't work properly.
- Florzporb's red attack projectile didn't fit its actual AOE.
- Lv 900-1000 monster's ATK/MATK/DEF/MDEF was wrong. Lv900 Mob stats was unintentionally lower than Lv899 mobs.
- Other minor bugs/typos

notes.title: Incremental Epic Hero 2 Playtest
notes.content:
Hi, I'm Hitan from the Hapiwaku IEH development team.
Today, we are pleased to announce a Playtest of Incremental Epic Hero 2!
This game is a reimagining of the original Incremental Epic Hero. A mixture of incremental/idle and roleplaying game set in a fantasy world filled with monsters and things to explore.

We are currently targeting official launch date on June 10th 2022. 
Toward that goal, we will conduct a public playtest for about a month. This will help us balance the game and improve other various aspects of the game in preparation for the official release.
Please try it and post any feedback! We are very active in Discord Community and open to hear your voice to improve the game and make it more fun! Even if you've never played IEH1, you will still enjoy IEH2 🙂

New Features
Though there are a lot of new features in IEH2, let me introduce some of them:

 In addition to the original 3 characters, Warrior/Wizard/Angel, 3 new characters are in IEH2! Thief, Archer and Tamer.
 A whole new prestige system for each class and the whole world!
 A Town building system that allows you to boost upgrades, unlock new areas, and other parts of the game.
 Chat feature in the game that makes gameplay more enjoyable!
 New graphics with full HD widescreen and super optimized game performance!


A Completely New Game Compared to IEH1
When we first announced about IEH2 in IEH1 page just a year ago, IEH2 was going to be just a remaster of IEH1, but over the past year, IEH2 has become a completely new game compared to IEH1! After several alpha and beta tests, and thanks to our test team and players in Discord, the game has taken an amazing leap forward over the past year.
With only about a month left until this official launch, we would love to have your help to make even more strides. Please join our Discord Community and post your great feedback 🙂
Also, please don't forget to add this game to your wishlist so that you don't miss the official release!

CAUTION
- Keep in mind that the save file of this Playtest will NOT be available in the official launch.
- All the contents, features and balances in the game are subject to change. 
- In-app purchase in this Playtest is not available. 


A Message from Dev. Morkyl
Hi everyone! I'm Morkyl, one of the game designers, here to express our gratitude for any feedback you can offer and to let you know that we are still hard at work designing even more to do and sculpting the game based very much on the feedback we receive.
